issue_title: OSS cleanup 2d: config, CI guards, fixture sensors and infra IDs
problem_statement:
OSS cleanup 2d: config, CI guards, fixture sensors and infra IDs

Part of #2231.

## Infra IDs
`config/install-database-map.json`, `config/protected-database-hosts.json`, runbooks (`break-glass`, `demo-refresh`, `neon-pitr-restore`, `pinned-install-promotion`, `docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md`) and `scripts/database-env-guard.test.mjs` contain real Neon project/endpoint names and Vercel project ids (not credentials, but they identify live infra). Builds read the map, so **don't just delete it**: ship a template (`*.example.json`) plus an env-supplied path, and keep real values only in each install's repo/config.

## References to removed ATA artifacts
`scripts/neon-rehearsal-cow-guard.mjs`, `neon-rehearsal-trust.test.mjs`, `pr-review-workflows.test.mjs`, `pr-risk-classifier.mjs`, `.github/workflows/{ci,preview-deploy-smoke,production-migrate,pr-review-evidence}.yml`, `.snyk`, `.gitleaksignore` (entries for deleted files), `lighthouserc.json`, `.env.example`, and the real-content sensors (`seed-real-content-manifest.json`, `scripts/lib/seed-fixture-guards.mjs`, `real-content-fixture-branding-sensor*.mjs`, `update-real-content-manifest-digests.mjs`, `agent-archive-data.test.mjs`). Update or remove them so CI is green without the deleted ATA files.
